sources.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
sources.observation: The framework stores reflective feedback separately from interaction trajectories and conditions later action choices on the resulting memory.
sources.adaptation: Separate evidence from a concise revisable lesson; require a visible effect on the next allocation rationale.
sources.limit: Reflection is not a new molecular measurement; do not import autonomous retry/reset or a fixed recent-memory length.

sources.title: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
sources.observation: The system evaluates agent variants and preserves a branching archive, including useful non-best variants; archive eligibility requires functional code-editing agents.
sources.adaptation: Keep configuration and skill-version lineages, alternatives and their evaluation provenance rather than only the latest winner.
sources.limit: Our raw failure ledger is retained separately from usable parents; no self-modifying scientific code, new population budget or demonstrated recursive gain is inferred.

sources.title: Large Language Models to Enhance Bayesian Optimization
sections: 2.1, The Integration of LLMs into BO
sources.observation: Observed parameter-score pairs form optimization history used in task-specific prompts for candidate sampling and surrogate modeling.
sources.adaptation: Keep exact configuration/metric pairs and comparison conditions separate from summaries and task instructions.
sources.limit: Do not invent a posterior, acquisition score or cross-teacher transfer of calibrated weights.

sources.title: Automatic LQR Tuning Based on Gaussian Process Global Optimization
sources.observation: Past parameter-cost evaluations update a Gaussian process; information-oriented experiment choice is separate from the current best guess. Evaluation records state/control trajectories.
sources.adaptation: Link interval weights to actual increment/trajectory diagnostics, and distinguish information value from mean performance.
sources.limit: The molecular sampler is not an LQR system; no linear dynamics, surrogate uncertainty or stability guarantee is assumed.

sources.title: AIDE: AI-Driven Exploration in the Space of Code
sources.observation: A search tree retains evaluated solutions; a summary operator selects performance, settings and debugging hints rather than appending every log.
sources.adaptation: Use evidence-linked working context and distinguish execution errors from valid poor results, while preserving complete source lineage.
sources.limit: Do not drop full source records, claim summary coverage is complete or import extra evaluation/retry permissions.

interpretation: RSI is used as an evaluated agent-instruction/workflow improvement analogy, not demonstrated autonomous recursive self-improvement.
